canonical_definition: Harmlessness refers to the avoidance of generating harmful, toxic, biased, or unsafe content, serving as a key alignment objective often constrained by safety requirements and sometimes traded off with helpfulness. Some papers operationalize it through refusal of malicious prompts or as a reward attribute in frameworks like HH-RLHF, while others highlight its limited capture by knowledge/logic benchmarks.
